svg.title: Which designs keep up, at 1,000 nodes
svg.desc: Six grids of privacy share by transaction rate: one column per fold timing, one row per prover, calibration v2 prices. On the fast prover every cell holds. On four Ryzen cores every fold timing holds every rate without privacy. With privacy the EIP's 1,000 ms tick holds nothing, its worst seeds including 9-61%; the 2,000 ms tick holds a fifth private at 10 and 20 tx/s; tickless holds those and half private at 10 tx/s; nothing private holds at 45 or 60 tx/s.
svg.text: Which designs keep up, at 1,000 nodes
Share included on the worst of 8 seeds (%, rounded down). Raw transactions pushed to every node; a privacy witness costs one nested proof.
The fast prover: a 2-to-1 fold in 303 ms
